# RobotVerse

> RobotVerse is a B2B marketplace and auction platform for new, used and refurbished industrial robots and robot spare parts in India, based in Chennai. Buyers compare verified listings, request quotations and bid in auctions; sellers list robots, parts and robotics services.

Listings carry structured specifications (brand, model, payload, reach, year, controller, condition, location) and prices in INR where the seller has published one. Seller contact details are masked; buyers request quotes through the platform.

## Main sections

- [Industrial robots](https://www.robotverse.in/robots): all robot listings; each listing lives at https://www.robotverse.in/robots/{id}
- [Robots by brand](https://www.robotverse.in/robots/brand/fanuc): brand pages at https://www.robotverse.in/robots/brand/{brand} (FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots and more)
- [Robots by city](https://www.robotverse.in/robots/city/chennai): city pages at https://www.robotverse.in/robots/city/{city}
- [Robot spare parts](https://www.robotverse.in/parts): parts at https://www.robotverse.in/parts/{id}, brand pages at https://www.robotverse.in/parts/brand/{brand}
- [Robotics directory](https://www.robotverse.in/directory): robot models, end-of-arm tools, external axes and training
- [Automation Studio 3D](https://www.robotverse.in/automation-studio/3d): simulate a robot cell in 3D from a process description
- [Automation Studio](https://www.robotverse.in/automation-studio): process-to-robot recommendation planner
- [Auctions](https://www.robotverse.in/auctions): live and upcoming robot auctions at https://www.robotverse.in/auctions/{id}
- [RoboBook](https://www.robotverse.in/robobook): guides, buying advice and community posts
- [Robotics services](https://www.robotverse.in/services): installation, programming, AMC and repair providers
- [Robot talent](https://www.robotverse.in/robot-talent): robotics jobs and training
- [Buyer guide](https://www.robotverse.in/buyer-guide): how to buy a used industrial robot in India
- [Seller guide](https://www.robotverse.in/seller-guide): how to list and sell robots and parts
